description: Disposition tree committed by the propagation statement at entry 22. The tree itself is well formed; the propagation it belongs to names a CHALLENGE as its trigger (core spec §2.3.3), so no `propagation-complete` receipt over it can verify — see receipts/propagation-complete-challenge-trigger-must-fail.ahl.
sort_rule: leaves sorted ascending by the UTF-8 bytes of the canonical `record` commitment string; non-canonical strings and duplicates are rejected (core spec §2.5)
